verdict.rationale: Obsidian has first-party developer documentation for building TypeScript plugins and a public obsidian-api repo that documents interfaces such as Vault. It also offers a tutorial in which you compile a sample plugin from source and load it into Obsidian, which gives a runnable example, though not an interactive one. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or lets you run examples in place. Missing for 10: interactive explorable API reference, in-browser/in-place runnable examples, AI-native or agent-oriented API docs, independent corroboration of reference quality.
